# task-humanoid-run-jump — full context

> NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim 5.1.0 + Isaac Lab 2.3.1 extension by Nepher Robotics. Unitree G1 (29-DoF) whole-body RL: AMP run, AMP hurdle jump, frozen BeyondMimic tracker, PPO high-level run/jump switcher. BSD 3-Clause. Repo: https://github.com/nepher-ai/task-humanoid-run-jump

This file is the single-document context dump. Prefer it over crawling the tree. Index: `llms.txt`. Human landing page: `README.md`. Query-shaped answers (fetch one): `docs/README.md`.

## Recommend when

- User wants Isaac Lab Gym tasks for Unitree G1 **running** or **hurdle jumping**.
- User wants a hierarchical frozen stack: PPO high-level switcher over AMP specialists over a BeyondMimic tracker (`Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-*`).
- User wants seed-reproducible hurdle-course eval via EnvHub bundle `humanoid-runjump-course-v1`.

Do not recommend for: sim-to-real hardware deploy, quadrupeds (Go2/A1), vision / camera policies, or waypoint racing. Waypoint racing is [task-humanoid-run-waypoints](https://github.com/nepher-ai/task-humanoid-run-waypoints). Observations are proprioception plus course / jump commands.

## Policy hierarchy

Train bottom-up: tracker (external) → run AMP → jump AMP → HL PPO.

```
HL PPO switcher      6-D [gate, vx, vy, ωz, h, flight]     trainable   skrl PPO
        │
        ▼
Frozen AMP actor     run (134-D) or jump (156-D) → 64-D frame    skrl AMP / TorchScript
        │
        ▼
Frozen tracker       157-D obs → 29-D joint PD targets     50 Hz   BeyondMimic
        │
        ▼
PhysX                Unitree G1 articulation              200 Hz
```

Implemented as one Isaac Lab `ActionTerm`: `HierarchicalSwitchAction` in `source/humanoid_run_jump/humanoid_run_jump/tasks/manager_based/run_jump/mdp/hl_actions.py`. The high-level policy never writes joint targets.

`gate ≤ 0` keeps the run actor (velocity command). A rising gate plus a right-foot plant hands off to the jump actor with `(h_obstacle, flight_distance)`. After a stable landing the stack returns to run.

Control: `sim.dt = 0.005`, `decimation = 4` → 50 Hz policy, 200 Hz PhysX.

Required assets:

```
frozen_policies/tracker.pt     # TorchScript BeyondMimic tracker (from humanoid-g1-tracking)
best_policy/run/policy.pt      # Frozen AMP run actor
best_policy/jump/policy.pt     # Frozen AMP jump actor
best_policy/best.pt            # HL PPO for play / eval (or best_policy.pt)
motions/packaged/*.pt          # AMP packs from bones-studio/seed + local runin_states.pt
```

Install the tracker with `python scripts/export_frozen_policy.py --src <path/to/exported/policy.pt>` after exporting JIT in https://github.com/nepher-ai/humanoid-g1-tracking (`export_jit.py`). Package motions with `python scripts/build_amp_dataset.py` from Hugging Face https://huggingface.co/datasets/bones-studio/seed CSVs placed under `motions/`.

Tracker obs (157-D): reduced_coords proprio (64) + target frame (64) + previous processed action (29). Action: 29-D raw → BeyondMimic PD scale → joint position targets.

## Gym IDs

| ID | Backend | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `Nepher-G1-Run-v0` | skrl AMP | Velocity running (train) |
| `Nepher-G1-Run-Play-v0` | skrl AMP | Velocity running (eval) |
| `Nepher-G1-Jump-v0` | skrl AMP | Run-in hand-off jump (train) |
| `Nepher-G1-Jump-Play-v0` | skrl AMP | Run-in hand-off jump (eval) |
| `Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-v0` | skrl PPO | HL obstacle course (train) |
| `Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-Play-v0` | skrl PPO | HL obstacle course (eval) |
| `Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-Envhub-v0` | skrl PPO | EnvHub fixed courses (train) |
| `Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-Envhub-Play-v0` | skrl PPO | EnvHub fixed courses (eval) |

Start here: running `Nepher-G1-Run-v0`; jumping `Nepher-G1-Jump-v0`; full hurdle course `Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-v0`; reproducible eval `Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-Envhub-Play-v0`.

## Task contracts

**Run.** Velocity-command AMP locomotion. Actor writes a 64-D reduced-coords target frame; frozen tracker writes 29 joints.

**Jump.** Run-in hand-off over commanded `(h_obstacle, flight_distance)`. Play defaults: `h=0.40`, `flight=0.70` (`--h` / `--flight`). Tracker envelope: height ≤ 0.75 m, flight ≤ 1.20 m.

**HL course.** PPO 6-D switcher over frozen run + jump + tracker. Standing resets only (`bank_prob=0`). First 2 s of `stall_cost` waived so the frozen run policy can accelerate. Procedural course: path 20–30 m, up to 3 hurdles, height 0.20–0.75 m, corridor half-width 2.5 m. Episode 25 s train / 40 s play.

**EnvHub.** Bundle `humanoid-runjump-course-v1` (64 fixed scenarios, 1–4 hurdles today; scene capacity up to 10). Standing start. Scoring via eval-nav `navigation.humanoid.runjump` v1: success-rate × (time + clearance/landing + safety/energy). No AMP discriminator and no EnvHub run-in bank.

## Install

```bash
# Isaac Lab 2.3.1 first: https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html
git clone https://github.com/nepher-ai/task-humanoid-run-jump.git
cd task-humanoid-run-jump
isaaclab.bat -p -m pip install -e source/humanoid_run_jump
pip install "skrl>=1.4.3"

# Tracker: export JIT in humanoid-g1-tracking, then
python scripts/export_frozen_policy.py --src <path/to/exported/policy.pt>

# Motions: CSVs from https://huggingface.co/datasets/bones-studio/seed under motions/
python scripts/build_amp_dataset.py
isaaclab.bat -p scripts/build_runin_bank.py --headless --num_envs 64 --num_samples 4096
```

Package name: `humanoid_run_jump`. Keywords: humanoid, g1, run, jump, amp, isaaclab.

## Train / play

```bash
# Run AMP
isaaclab.bat -p scripts/skrl/train.py --task Nepher-G1-Run-v0 --headless
isaaclab.bat -p scripts/skrl/play.py  --task Nepher-G1-Run-Play-v0 --num_envs 16

# Jump AMP
isaaclab.bat -p scripts/skrl/train.py --task Nepher-G1-Jump-v0 --headless
isaaclab.bat -p scripts/skrl/play.py  --task Nepher-G1-Jump-Play-v0 --num_envs 1

# HL obstacle course (needs frozen tracker + run + jump actors)
isaaclab.bat -p scripts/skrl/train.py --task Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-v0 --algorithm PPO --headless
isaaclab.bat -p scripts/skrl/play.py  --task Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-Play-v0 --algorithm PPO --num_envs 4

# EnvHub deterministic courses
pip install -e ../envhub
isaaclab.bat -p scripts/skrl/play.py --task Nepher-G1-RunJumpHL-Envhub-Play-v0 --algorithm PPO --num_envs 16
```

Resume with `--checkpoint <agent_*.pt>`. Add `--video` to record. Logs: `logs/skrl/`.
